mentions.name: whisper-ctranslate2 subtitle wrapper
mentions.description: A thin wrapper around whisper-ctranslate2 that auto-subtitles videos already stored locally, written for self-hosted use to support language learning. The author forces a language manually because automatic language detection proved unreliable.
mentions.problem: There was no self-hosted tool to auto-subtitle locally stored videos, which would help with language learning.
mentions.source_excerpt: It seems that all I need is a thin wrapper around whisper-ctranslate2. So I wrote one and am playing with it right now.

evidence.value: It seems that all I need is a thin wrapper around whisper-ctranslate2. So I wrote one and am playing with it right now.
